And there have been countless major improvements proposed. For instance one idea somebody proposed that was really interesting was having a user's up/downvotes only reflect sorting of content for them. If you downvote somebody, the algorithm would make it where you'll be less likely to see content from this user - but you don't affect how likely I am to see their content. This would even allow cool and unprecedented things (on these sort of sites) like having completely opposing viewpoints both co-exist within the same sub.
